name: Thai iced tea with half and half
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai iced tea, the first recipe (4 cups water, 1/2 cup Thai tea mix, 3/4 cup sugar, 1 cup half and half for 4 glasses): per glass 250 g of tea, 37 g of sugar (3/4 cup over 4 glasses) and 60 g of half and half (1 cup over 4); 40 g of water stands for the ice that melts. The tea mix itself is brewed out.
